title: After a pilot mesh-belt furnace trial works, what still needs verifying before scaling up?
summary: A project requirements record lists both a production mesh-belt furnace and a small experimental mesh-belt furnace. Both are intended to reproduce the same heating, holding and binder-removal conditions, but the experimental unit has no capacity requirement, and production loading and target output remain unconfirmed. After successful small-specimen trials, production loading, effective heated length and exhaust-maintenance conditions still need assessment. Equipment size alone cannot establish production capacity.
